title: Monero GUI wallets
whyItMatters: Monero wallet files and keys. Anyone with them and the password can move the funds.
source: monero-gui official repo, src/main/main.cpp sets moneroAccountsDir to QStandardPaths::HomeLocation + /Monero/wallets on macOS - https://github.com/monero-project/monero-gui/blob/master/src/main/main.cpp
notes: The wizard can place wallets elsewhere; only the default is checked.

cleanup.exportFirst: Open each wallet in Monero GUI and write down its recovery phrase, or save its keys file to a drive you keep.
steps: Confirm you have the recovery phrase or keys file for every wallet in this folder.
Quit Monero GUI so the wallet files are not in use.
Delete the wallets folder named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Wallet files and keys leave this Mac. Without the phrase or keys file the funds cannot be recovered.
cleanup.source: Monero, Restoring a wallet from private keys: https://www.getmonero.org/resources/user-guides/restore_from_keys.html
